name: Tom Homan
role: US border czar; former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement
summary: Homan advocates strict immigration enforcement, expanded detention and deportation, and federal action against sanctuary policies. He defends deterrence policies, including family separation, while describing lawful immigration and asylum adjudication as legitimate.

sources.title: Testimony on Migrant Protection Protocols, November 2019
sources.author: Thomas D. Homan

sources.author: Paul Moses / Commonweal
